params.prompt: Wide-angle photograph, 24 mm lens at f/8, deep focus from the stones at the waterline to the horizon, camera one metre above the ground on the shore of a still lagoon, behind a small group of spectators, level and slightly tilted up. In the lower fifth of the frame: the dark shoreline, two boxy 1960s cars and six or seven black silhouettes of people seen from behind, standing still on the hoods and beside the cars, less than one tenth of the frame height, no faces. Far across the water, at three fifths of the frame width, a colossal column of fire and cream-white smoke climbs straight up from the horizon and leaves the top of the frame; the column glows from inside like a lantern with orange fire, is amber on its sunlit side and falls into soft cream shadow on the other; the rocket itself is only a bright point at the head of the flame near the top edge. The calm water mirrors the column. Huge pale blue sky. Colour of 1960s 16 mm reversal film: amber, cream and faded blue, slightly lifted warm blacks. No markings, letters, flags or symbols anywhere. Clean image without film grain or borders. No text, no logos, no insignia, no emblems, no watermark.
